_comment: What jarvis-core's calendar.events service answers for one invitation, and the iCalendar it was read from. aura-core/tests/test_calendar_invitations.py parses `ical` and requires `events` to be what the service says; hermes/plugins/jarvis-calendar/tests/test_calendar.py feeds `events` through the plugin. Neither side holds the shape on its own.
ical:
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:inv-1
DTSTART:20261012T090000Z
DTEND:20261012T100000Z
SUMMARY:Kickoff
LOCATION:Room 4
ORGANIZER;CN="Boss, The":mailto:boss@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Owner;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:Owner@Example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Pat;PARTSTAT=ACCEPTED;ROLE=OPT-PARTICIPANT:mailto:pat@example.com
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
